# Test fixtures

This directory documents the generated-fixture policy for the storage slice. Fixture helpers themselves live next to the tests that use them so they stay dependency-local and are never accidentally shipped as production code.

## Policy

- Every fixture is generated at runtime into an isolated temporary directory (`tempfile::tempdir`).
- No test reads a real profile, user database, Keychain item, provider credential, or environment secret.
- Encrypted SQLCipher fixtures are created with `deepchat_services::connection::open_database` and the locked binding below; nothing is committed to disk as a pre-made database.
- Generated fixtures are deleted with their temporary directory when the test process exits.

## Helpers

| Helper | Location | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `create_encrypted_db` | `crates/deepchat-services/tests/storage_contract.rs` | Generates an isolated SQLCipher-4 encrypted database with a UTF-8 key and WAL mode |
| `FakeProvider` | `crates/deepchat-services/tests/storage_contract.rs` | Drives the password-resolver retry loop without any UI |
| `TestClock` | `crates/deepchat-services/src/schema.rs`, `src/startup_recovery.rs`, `tests/storage_contract.rs` | Deterministic `applied_at` / quarantine-stamp values |
| `FakeKeychainClient` | `crates/deepchat-platform/src/keychain.rs` | Injected Keychain fake; never touches the real Keychain |
| `ManualFallbackSecretStore` | `crates/deepchat-platform/src/manual.rs` | Manual fallback store used directly by tests |

## Fixture metadata

The SQLCipher fixture generated by the contract test has these reproducible properties:

- Cipher: SQLCipher compatibility `4` (`cipher='sqlcipher'`, `legacy=4`).
- Key: UTF-8 password bytes applied before `journal_mode = WAL`.
- Journal: WAL mode, confirmed by `PRAGMA journal_mode` returning `wal`.
- Isolation: single temporary directory, no side effects outside it.
